name: Airbus A320neo
sources: Sources. [A320] Airbus AC A320 (2025-01) https://www.aircraft.airbus.com/sites/g/files/jlcbta126/files/2025-01/AC_A320_0624.pdf: span 34.10 m with fences, 35.80 m with sharklets (p.40, p.42); sharklet 2.43 m from its tip to the wing's lower-surface line extended, 2.64 m all in (p.42, p.50); the blend starts 16.29 m from the centre line, the tip 17.90 m (p.43); off the p.42 drawing: 6° cant, leading edge 40° and trailing edge 27° from vertical, chord 1.57 m at the wing, 0.9 m where the straight part starts, 0.45 m at the rounded tip, the blend about 1.3 m out and 0.8 m up.

Nacelles [A320]: CFM56-5B 2.3 m tall, 2.07-2.1 m wide, 3.43 m to the fan exhaust (p.124); LEAP-1A 2.52 × 2.60 m, 4.1 m to the fan nozzle (p.135); PW1100G 2.60 × 2.67 m, 4.3 m (p.131); inlet 11.19 m (ceo) vs 11.14 m (neo) from the nose (p.41, p.45); engine clearance 0.577 m (ceo) vs 0.46 m (neo) at MTOW (p.48, p.51): the axis stays, the bigger nacelle takes the clearance. The A320 mesh's cowl measures 2.12 × 2.30 m. neo: the mean of LEAP-1A and PW1100G (Royal Jordanian flies LEAP-1A, Wizz Air PW1100G).
